auth.registerSubtitle: Sign up for Reelpath. Set up your channels from the dashboard afterward.

landing.taglinePart2: from script to published YouTube video.
landing.demoCopy: A real educational channel built with Reelpath — script, voice, stock and AI images, review, and YouTube publishing.
landing.demoVideoSoonDesc: In the meantime, explore the live channel on YouTube to see the final result.
landing.stepProductionDesc: Pick a topic or let the system suggest one. Script, voice, visuals, and editing in a single flow.
landing.stepReviewDesc: Watch each video and its Shorts before publishing. You decide what goes live.
landing.stepPublishDesc: Publish to YouTube instantly or schedule a date. Long-form and vertical Shorts.
landing.feature2: Voice, visuals, and editing ready for review
landing.feature3: YouTube publishing: long-form and vertical Shorts
landing.pricingCopy: Start with a 14-day free trial. When you're ready, pick the monthly plan that fits your publishing pace.
landing.payPerVideoNote: coming soon. For now, the free trial and monthly plans cover the full production and YouTube publishing workflow.
landing.faqAiA: YouTube doesn't ban AI, but it requires transparency when content is clearly synthetic. Reelpath includes human review before publishing: you approve each video and publish to your own connected account.
landing.faqControlQ: Do I lose control of my channel?
landing.faqControlA: No. You connect your YouTube account via OAuth and Reelpath only publishes what you approve. You can disconnect the integration at any time.
landing.faqEducationalQ: Does it work for educational channels like history documentaries?
landing.faqEducationalA: Yes. Channels like «{channelName}» use Reelpath to produce scripts, voice, and visuals with a documentary tone, review each piece, and publish long-form and Shorts on YouTube.
landing.faqCopyrightA: You define the niche, blocked topics, and editorial guidelines per channel. Reelpath generates content under your settings; the final review is yours before publishing.
landing.aboutP1: {appName} is a platform for teams producing YouTube channels at scale: documentaries, educational niches, long-form, and Shorts. It generates scripts, voice, visuals, and videos ready for review, and publishes to the creator's connected account.
landing.aboutP2: The YouTube integration lets you connect your channel via OAuth and publish videos and Shorts after manual review. {appName} does not collect subscriber data or sell personal information to third parties.
landing.demoChannelTagline: History curiosities they never taught you — on YouTube
landing.demoChannelDesc: Private content creation tool: generates educational scripts, voice, visuals, and videos, and publishes them to the creator's YouTube accounts (long-form and vertical Shorts).
landing.demoFeature2: Voice, visuals, and video ready for review
landing.demoFeature3: YouTube publishing: long-form and vertical Shorts
landing.planCreatorDesc: For creators publishing steadily (~2 long videos per week) who want to automate their channel.
landing.planCreatorBullet2: 1 channel and manual review before publishing
landing.planProDesc: The go-to plan for running a channel seriously without building a full in-house team.
landing.planStudioDesc: For agencies, studios, and multi-channel operators who need volume and flexibility.
